items.detail: Korean Air, economy, one checked bag. Already in California since the 22nd on the Trybal SoCal trip (tracked separately) - no positioning flight to buy, just get to the international terminal.

Same booking. Four and a half hours on the ground at Incheon. All international flights use T5, which has its own Line 14 metro station: Line 14 to Xi'an North, then Line 4 to Dayanta and the hotel door. One change, ~30 min, Y7-8. Budget an hour for immigration - China takes fingerprints on arrival.

Soft sleeper, confirmed with James on 16 August. No physical ticket - board by laying the passport on the gate scanner; a photo or the number alone will not do. Thirty hours up the Qinghai-Tibet railway. Sharing a twin with Jeff, so the RMB 2,100 single supplement goes to Kamana or Alka. Depart from Xi'an Railway Station (西安站, No. 44 Huancheng North Road) - NOT Xi'an North, which is the high-speed station. Single Line 4 ride from Dayanta. Leave the hotel by 08:00: airport-style security, sometimes twice, water scanned with a special reader, and the scrum at the doors is for luggage space.

China Eastern on Delta miles: 30,000 miles + Y170. Changes planes at Xi'an. Lands at Hongqiao, not Pudong. Tour ends with the shared transfer to Gonggar. Bags clear around 22:20 and the last Line 11 is ~22:30-23:00 with a change at Jiangsu Road - you will not make it, so budget a Didi: ~50 km, 60-70 min, Y180-250.
Delta Main. Ticket 0062450696002. Y4,653. Departs Pudong, not the Hongqiao you arrive into - Pudong is a 25-minute taxi from the Disney area against an hour from People's Square. Taxi around 15:00.

Seat 28A. The return half of the separate SoCal round trip, not the China ticket. Seven and a half hours at LAX between the two, which sounds generous but they are separate tickets: collect the bag, clear customs and immigration, re-check it and possibly change terminals. Comfortable, not automatic.
